dedupe_keys.name: swvo space weather data readers for python gfz

description: SWVO is a Python package from GFZ that reads, downloads and processes solar and geomagnetic data through one reader class per index and source. The GFZ Helmholtz Centre for Geosciences publishes it with four named contributors. It covers the Kp index (OMNI, SWPC, Niemegk, BGS, SIDC and ensembles), Dst (OMNI and WDC), the Hp30 and Hp60 indices, F10.7 solar flux, SuperMAG electrojet indices and substorm onset catalogues, solar wind from ACE, DSCOVR, IMAP, OMNI, SWIFT ensembles, ENLIL runs and a merged L1 record, and PAGER plasmasphere density predictions, with functions that combine sources. Coverage is whatever each upstream archive holds. Format and access: an open source repository installed with uv or pip, with example notebooks. Licence: Apache-2.0; free, though SuperMAG data need a SuperMAG account. Caveats: it depends on upstream servers staying reachable and on their own licences. It helps prepare inputs for geomagnetically induced current, satellite drag and radiation models used in hazard exposure studies. Related catalogue records are the GFZ Kp index and the OMNI solar wind data, two of the sources it reads.
